entities.description: Historic research and Shuttle Carrier aircraft associated with NASA. Retired aircraft are not presented as live flights.
Public-service aircraft used for hurricane and atmospheric research. Observation availability varies by receiver coverage.
Two Boeing 767 aircraft publicly associated with the team. These aircraft also serve other missions; an observation does not identify the passengers.
Selected aircraft with documented sports liveries. These are airline aircraft, not evidence of team ownership or a team travelling aboard.
An Alaska Airlines aircraft unveiled with a Kraken commemorative livery in 2024. Branding does not make it a dedicated team transport.
The documented 2021 Giants-themed Alaska Airlines A320. This historical livery entry does not claim that the paint scheme or operator is current.
Selected flight-test aircraft and their engineering history. The ZA004 Dreamliner was retired in February 2026.
Selected airline heritage aircraft, including the Hekla Aurora special livery. Hekla Aurora left service in October 2025.
The Flying Eye Hospital: an aircraft equipped for ophthalmic training. Aircraft movement does not establish patient or staff identities.
A public display and heritage aircraft collection. These entries describe the aircraft collection, not private individuals or their travel.
New York Jets branding documented on a JetBlue Airbus A320. This is a regular airline aircraft, not a confirmed team charter. Current paint scheme and passengers are unknown.
Boston Celtics branding documented on a JetBlue Airbus A320. This is a regular airline aircraft, not a confirmed team charter. Current paint scheme and passengers are unknown.
Boston Bruins branding documented on a JetBlue Airbus A320. This is a regular airline aircraft, not a confirmed team charter. Current paint scheme and passengers are unknown.
Brooklyn Nets branding documented on a JetBlue Airbus A320. This is a regular airline aircraft, not a confirmed team charter. Current paint scheme and passengers are unknown.
Boston Red Sox branding documented on a JetBlue Airbus A320. This is a regular airline aircraft, not a confirmed team charter. Current paint scheme and passengers are unknown.
Aircraft listed in Finnair’s published fleet, including regional aircraft operated by Norra. Availability and observations vary.
